memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their homes. (To the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given land in Bashan, and to the other half of the tribe Joshua gave land on the west side of the Jordan along with their fellow Israelites.) When Joshua sent them home, he blessed them, saying, "Return to your homes with your great wealth — with large herds of livestock, with silver, gold, bronze and iron, and a great quantity of clothing — and divide the plunder from your enemies with your fellow Israelites." — Josh 22:6-8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The tribes go home rich — herds, silver, gold, bronze, iron, clothing. God had provided abundantly. But notice Joshua's instruction attached to the blessing: "divide the plunder from your enemies with your fellow Israelites." The wealth was not only for those who carried it home; it was to be shared with the brothers who had stayed behind to guard the families and lands.

This is an important guardrail for our hearts. The Bible never treats material blessing as a reward to hoard or a sign of superior faith. What God gives, He gives partly so that we can be generous. The blessing here comes wrapped in a command to share.

We must be careful never to twist God's provision into a prosperity message that says faith guarantees riches. These tribes were blessed, yes — but the point of the story is not "obey and get wealthy." The point is that whatever God entrusts to us is meant to bless others too.

The New Testament makes this plain: God enriches us so that we can be generous on every occasion (2 Cor 9:11). True wealth in God's eyes is measured not by what we keep but by what we gladly give. Let whatever God has placed in your hands become a means of blessing those around you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you see what you own as yours alone, or as something to share?
2. How can you use God's provision to bless others this week?
3. Are you guarding your heart against measuring faith by wealth?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for Your generous provision. Guard my heart from greed, and make me a channel of blessing to others with whatever You place in my hands. Amen.
